533.text: my strict little sister - in - law a trifle more

quotes.text: “I wonder when in the world you’re going to do anything, Rudolf?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“why in the world
should I do anything? My position is a comfortable one. I have an
income nearly sufficient for my wants (no one’s income is ever quite
sufficient, you know), I enjoy an enviable social position: I am
brother to Lord Burlesdon, and brother-in-law to that charming lady, his
countess. Behold, it is enough!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Knock about? It is true. Our family doesn’t need to do things.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Good families are generally worse than any others,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “She objects to my doing nothing and having red hair,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Oh! of course he can’t help his hair,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “It generally crops out once in a generation,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“So does
the nose. Rudolf has got them both.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I wish you’d take that picture away, Robert,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I rather like being an Elphberg myself.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“is that he recognizes the duties of his position, and you
see the opportunities of yours.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “To a man of spirit, my dear Rose,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Now, here’s Sir Jacob Borrodaile offering you exactly what you might be
equal to.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“He’s to have an Embassy in six months, and Robert says he is sure that
he’ll take you as an attache. Do take it, Rudolf--to please me.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“My dear sister, if in six months’ time no unforeseen obstacle has
arisen, and Sir Jacob invites me, hang me if I don’t go with Sir Jacob!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Oh, Rudolf, how good of you! I am glad!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “He doesn’t know yet; but it’s sure to be a good Embassy.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“for your sake I’ll go, if it’s no more than a
beggarly Legation. When I do a thing, I don’t do it by halves.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
